exposure: Motor impairment due to rare diseases
cohort: 22 pregnant women or young mothers with motor impairment due to rare diseases
finding: While infants of mothers with motor impairment showed normal development, mother-infant interactions were altered in half the participants, highlighting the need for parenting support regardless of the mother's physical independence.
mod_finding: This study on mothers with motor impairment due to rare diseases found a high rate of cesarean sections (9 out of 22 births) and assisted vaginal deliveries (6 out of 22 births).
